좋아하다.e: 좋다 (good) + -아하다 (show a feeling). 좋아요 = it's good; 좋아해요 = I like it.
좋아하다.t: 좋아하다 takes 을/를 (음식을 좋아해요); 좋다 takes 이/가 (음식이 좋아요). Pronounced [조아하다].

가볍다.e: ㅂ becomes 우: 가벼워요. Opposite: 무겁다.

구입하다.e: Literally 'buy in', bringing goods in by buying.
구입하다.t: More formal than 사다; you'll see it in stores, ads and writing. Pronounced [구이파다].

셋째.ex: 여행 셋째 날에는 가족과 바닷가에 갔어요.
셋째.x: On the third day of the trip, I went to the beach with my family.

계곡.x: In the summer I went to a mountain valley with my family.
계곡.e: Literally 'stream valley' — a mountain valley with a creek.

염색.x: I got my hair dyed at the salon over the weekend.

활용.ex: 시간 활용을 잘하면 공부와 운동을 다 할 수 있어요.
활용.x: If you use your time well, you can both study and exercise.
활용.e: Literally 'living use' — putting something to active use.
활용.t: In grammar books, 활용 means conjugation, like 가다 becoming 가요.

취향.t: 취향 저격 'hits my taste exactly' is popular slang for something you love.

감상하다.m: to appreciate, to enjoy (art, music, films)
감상하다.x: On weekends, I rest at home enjoying music.
감상하다.t: 음악 감상 'listening to music' is a classic answer when Koreans list hobbies.

여쭙다.forms: 여쭈워요 · 여쭈웠어요 · 여쭈울 거예요 (ㅂ irregular; humble, not used with -(으)세요)
여쭙다.ex: 교수님께 한 가지 여쭙고 싶은 게 있어요.
여쭙다.x: There's one thing I'd like to ask you, Professor.
여쭙다.e: Humble verb: it lowers the asker rather than raising the listener. 여쭈다 is an equally standard variant.
여쭙다.t: Pronounced [여쭙따]: the final ㅂ makes the next ㄷ tense. Use it with 께 when asking teachers, bosses or elders. In speech 여쭤보다 is most common.

설립하다.m: to establish, to found, to set up
설립하다.x: My grandfather founded this company in 1970.
설립하다.e: Literally 'set up and make stand' — used for companies, schools and organizations.
설립하다.t: Use 설립되다 for 'to be founded': 이 학교는 1950년에 설립되었어요.

희생자.ex: 많은 사람들이 희생자의 가족을 위해 기도했어요.
희생자.x: Many people prayed for the victims' families.
희생자.e: 희생 'sacrifice' originally meant an animal offered in a ritual; + -자 'person.'
희생자.t: 희생자 usually implies loss of life; 피해자 is any victim of harm, like fraud or crime.

여당.ex: 여당은 이번 선거에서 많은 의석을 잃었습니다.
여당.x: The ruling party lost many seats in this election.
여당.e: Literally 'the party siding with' the government.
여당.t: Remember the pair: 여당 'ruling party' vs. 야당 'opposition party'.

순박하다.x: The people in the country village were simple, honest and kind.
순박하다.e: Literally 'pure and plain,' like uncarved wood.
순박하다.t: Pronounced [순바카다] — ㄱ plus ㅎ becomes a strong [ㅋ].

과묵하다.x: He doesn't talk much, but he's a very warm person.

수법.x: Scammers' tricks are getting more and more sophisticated.
수법.e: Literally 'hand method': the way someone does something.

수축.x: Metal contracts little by little when the temperature drops.

검역.x: The airport tightened quarantine checks on arriving travelers.

버겁다.m: too much to handle, overwhelming, beyond one's ability
버겁다.ex: 혼자 이 일을 다 하기에는 너무 버거워요.
버겁다.x: Doing all this work alone is too much for me.
버겁다.t: Often used as -기(에) 버겁다 'too much to …'.

사필귀정.m: justice will prevail; things end up where they should
사필귀정.x: The truth came out in the end — this is justice prevailing.
사필귀정.e: Literally 'all matters surely return to what is right'.

불똥이 튀다.forms: 불똥이 튀어요 · 불똥이 튀었어요 · ~에게 불똥이 튀다
불똥이 튀다.m: to get caught in the crossfire; for trouble to spread to others
불똥이 튀다.x: My older brothers were fighting, and I got caught in the crossfire.
불똥이 튀다.e: 불똥 = a spark; literally 'sparks fly' onto bystanders.

수입규제.x: The U.S. imposed import restrictions on Korean-made washing machines.
수입규제.t: Pronounced [수입뀨제]; don't confuse 수입 'import' (輸入) with 수입 'income' (收入).

회귀분석.ex: 우리는 회귀분석으로 두 변인의 관계를 살펴보았습니다.
회귀분석.x: We examined the relationship between the two variables using regression analysis.
회귀분석.e: Literally 'returning analysis' — from 'regression toward the mean'.

저항.x: The longer the wire, the greater the electrical resistance.
저항.t: Outside physics, 저항 means resisting people or power: 저항 운동 'resistance movement'.

화백.ex: 김 화백은 올해로 화가 생활 50년을 맞았습니다.
화백.x: Master painter Kim marks fifty years as an artist this year.
화백.e: Literally 'painting elder' — a respectful title for an established painter.
화백.t: Used as a title after a name, like 김 화백; never use it about yourself.

화성.ex: 이 곡은 단순한 멜로디에 풍부한 화성을 더했어요.
화성.x: This piece adds rich harmony to a simple melody.
화성.e: Literally 'harmonized sounds'. Homonym alert: 화성 is also Mars and the city Hwaseong.

시종일관.m: consistently, unwaveringly, all the way through
시종일관.x: He consistently maintained his innocence throughout the trial.
시종일관.e: Literally 'beginning and end pierced by one thread'.

화석연료.x: We need to reduce our dependence on fossil fuels.
화석연료.t: Pronounced [화성녈료]: ㄴ is inserted, then nasalization and ㄹ assimilation.

구명하다.m: to investigate thoroughly, to get to the bottom of
구명하다.ex: 과학자들은 질병의 원인을 구명하기 위해 노력하고 있습니다.
구명하다.x: Scientists are working to get to the bottom of the disease's cause.
구명하다.t: Homonym: 구명 (救命) means 'lifesaving,' as in 구명조끼 (life jacket).

짓이기다.m: to crush, to mash, to trample
짓이기다.ex: 마늘을 칼등으로 잘게 짓이겨서 찌개에 넣으세요.
짓이기다.x: Crush the garlic finely with the back of a knife and add it to the stew.
짓이기다.e: 짓- (roughly, hard) + 이기다 (to knead, mash) — not 이기다 'to win'.
짓이기다.t: Pronounced [진니기다] — an added ㄴ plus nasalization.

구상권.m: right of reimbursement, right of recourse
구상권.ex: 보험사는 사고를 낸 운전자에게 구상권을 행사했습니다.
구상권.x: The insurer exercised its right of recourse against the driver who caused the accident.
구상권.e: Literally 'right to seek compensation' from whoever was really responsible.
구상권.t: Pronounced [구상꿘]; nearly always paired with 행사하다 or 청구하다.
